Zebra Pen MILDLINER No Bleed Highlighter, Assorted Colors, Dual Tip, 15-Pk | Broad and Fine Point Tip Marker Set, Ideal for Bible Highlighting, Journaling, School, Teacher and Office Supplies (78115)
- Dual-Tip Highlighters for Study, Teaching & Creativity: Each Mildliner includes a broad chisel tip for highlighting and a fine bullet tip for underlining, grading papers, hand lettering, and detail work in notes, planners, and creative layouts.
- No-Bleed Ink Ideal for Bible Highlighting: Soft, translucent ink is designed to minimize bleed-through on thin pages, making these highlighters well suited for Bible study, devotionals, scripture journaling, and margin notes.
- Excellent for Creative Use & Layering: Water-resistant pigment ink allows colors to be layered once dry without smearing, making Mildliners ideal for bullet journaling, hand lettering, scrapbooking, planners, and other creative projects.
- Great for Teachers, Classrooms & School Supplies: A favorite among teachers and students for lesson planning, grading, color-coding, and organizing materials, these highlighters bring clarity and creativity to everyday school tasks.
- Convenient 15-Pack with Color-Coded Clips: Includes fifteen assorted Mildliner highlighters with matching clips for easy organization and quick selection, offering a versatile set for classrooms, offices, creative spaces, and home use.

 Source: the retailer listing for model 78115 and Zebra's product page, both read Nov. 9, 2026.

Who the 15-color set suits

The maker lists the uses itself: notes, planners, bullet journaling, hand lettering, scrapbooking, lesson planning, grading and Bible margins. The two tips split the work. The chisel end covers a whole line or fills a time block, and the bullet end underlines, ticks off tasks and draws small details. Fifteen colors leave room for a separate color for each area you track in a planner, with spares for headings and borders. Browse more writing tools in the pens category, or pair the set with a journal from dotted paper journals.

Who should pick a different set

The listing describes soft, translucent ink, so anyone who wants bright neon highlighting should look for a fluorescent set instead. Buyers who need exact tip widths or the color names before ordering will not find them in this listing. And the maker says bleed-through is minimized on thin pages, which is a reduction, not a guarantee, so try each color on the last page of a planner first.

Does Mildliner ink show through planner paper?

The maker designed the ink to limit bleed-through on thin pages, and paper weight decides the rest. Most planner listings do not state a paper weight: our comparison of 2027 planners shows which ones do. How to choose a planner covers the other details to check.

A simple color-coding setup

Give each area of life one color, write the key on the first page, and use the same colors on a wall or desk calendar so both match. A free printable monthly calendar is a cheap place to try the key before you mark up the planner itself.

How this page was made: the facts come from the maker listing, collected by the Fresh Calendars team with AI help and checked before publishing. We do not test products by hand.
